dedupe_keys.name: livorno urban driving automated and connected vehicle and smart traffic light

description: AUTOPILOT project partners publish separate urban-driving test-session deposits for traffic-light speed adaptation, pedestrian warnings, fallen bicycles and pothole detection. Vehicle CAN and GPS logs are described alongside V2X messages and exchanges through oneM2M. Sessions compare automated and connected vehicles, smartphone, IMU and 6LoWPAN pothole detectors, and intersections whose cameras detect jaywalking. The pothole descriptions specify 1.9 km laps on a harbour public road. Some filenames explicitly identify Turin or Trento pre-tests despite the Livorno pilot label; the group therefore does not imply that all sessions occurred in Livorno. One traffic-light deposit has empty scenario/session sections but identifies its vehicle/V2X/IoT contents and test-session files. Separate deposits and test runs remain individually linked. Technical evaluation data do not by themselves establish collision avoidance, detection accuracy or operational safety. Zenodo provides the described files free under CC BY 4.0. Only descriptions and file descriptors were inspected; archives, values, code and media remain unread. File availability does not verify completeness, internal formats or measurement quality.
